metadata.title: 3 History Facts They Never Taught You #Shorts
metadata.description: History is darker and stranger than school ever admitted. Which fact shocked you? Comment 1, 2, or 3. #Shorts #HistoryFacts #DarkHistory

audio_profile.bg_music_vibe: cinematic tension strings with distant war drums

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Three history facts they deliberately never taught you in school.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: old library ancient books candlelight dark moody cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact one. In nineteen eighteen, a mysterious sickness made people sleep for months.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: vintage hospital corridor 1920s eerie fog cinematic slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Victims woke up changed. Some never woke up at all. It vanished. No cure found.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: abandoned hospital bed dust moonlight eerie cinematic slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact two. Roman emperors drank tiny doses of poison every single day.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: ancient roman goblet wine dark candlelight macro cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Why? To build immunity. Because betrayal at dinner was Rome's favorite sport.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: roman banquet torchlight shadows ancient hall cinematic dramatic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact three. Victorians photographed their dead. Dressed them. Posed them. Eyes open.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: victorian antique photograph camera tripod dust vintage dark

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: To them, one last portrait was love. To us, it's a nightmare.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: old family portrait frame flickering candle dark moody macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: History isn't boring. It's just edited.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: old typewriter dusty paper ink dark moody macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Which fact shook you? Comment one, two, or three. Follow for more hidden history.
